The core Healthcare Business consists of the manufacture and sale of health foods and cosmetics under its own brands, and OEM manufacturing and supply of products for other companies' brands, such as drugstore chains. The Pharmaceutical Business, which covers the manufacture and sale of Kampo prescription drugs and general medicines and the sale of generic drugs, is carried out by subsidiary Honsō Seiyaku. entries.f81792c12201dc6a: A business that manufactures and sells Kampo (traditional Japanese herbal) prescription drugs and over-the-counter drugs and sells generic drugs, carried out by the subsidiary Honso Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, net sales were ¥2,471 million (107.0% of the previous year) and operating profit was ¥230 million (107.0% of the previous year). Orders for OEM (contract manufacturing for other companies' brands) of over-the-counter drugs increased, and sales were led by the in-house manufactured prescription generic drug "Pimuro Granules" (laxative), positioned as a priority product, and the generic lifestyle-improvement drugs "Sildenafil Tablets," "Finasteride Tablets" and "Tadalafil Tablets." Because the drug prices of prescription Kampo preparations rose in April 2024, a structure that can steadily produce a profit has been achieved, the securities report states.
